title: VXAce Ultra Lighting offset or rounded?

posts.author: Roninator2
posts.body:
Good day fellow makers.
I'm posting a question for something I just discovered I would like to do.
In my game I was making a map that will use Ultra Lighting and I placed some pillars in the map.
Well these pillars are not aligned with the map grid and they are round.
So I am wondering if anyone has a way to use the lighting with this type of elevation.
The documentation and code do not seem to have this idea thought of.
Short of redesigning the pillars to have the center aligned. Which might be the only answer.
